---
name: prime
description: Research an issue and provide verified context for automatic planning.
---

# Prime and Research
1. Read repository conventions and the selected issue through connected GitHub tools or authenticated gh; inspect related issues/PRs, dependencies and relevant scoped plans. Never claim unavailable access.
2. Extract the goal, exact acceptance criteria, constraints and prerequisites. Trace relevant production/tests/contracts and current persistence.
3. Do not modify source or Git/GitHub state. Separate verified facts from assumptions, include file paths and note real gaps.
4. Resolve routine choices from repo evidence. Return BLOCKED only for genuinely missing requirements, access or scope-changing decisions; do not ask a fixed interview questionnaire as a ceremony.
5. Return a Context Brief: issue summary, affected services/files, current behavior, dependency evidence, decisions, risks/open blockers and PASS/BLOCKED status.
6. In dispatcher mode, return directly for Plan in the same invocation. No CONFIRM step or human approval is required; final human review is on the PR.
